d:
In this video, I explain real interview questions about Delta Lake that are commonly asked during data engineer interviews. I guide you through theoretical and practical questions that reveal in-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with Delta Lake.
What you will learn:
• Types of files and folders associated with Delta tables
• Information stored within Delta logs
• How Delta Lake utilizes filters efficiently during data fetching
• Key features of Delta Lake, including time travel and schema enforcement
• Explanation of upsert and delete operations in Delta Lake
